comparison.objective: Cut a dead rose cane above an intact bud, retain the offcut and place it in a bin without harming live canes.
comparison.physical_skill: Target discrimination, secateur operation, bimanual cut-and-catch and delicate offcut transfer, versus screen grasping and controlled agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Cut and final stub 3–15 mm above the bud, bud/live canes intact, offcut never dropped and placed in bin, tool set down and 1 s clearance dwell. Candidate has media-yield and washer-retention criteria. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: Retaining one freed offcut is not equivalent to separating many loose objects by aperture size; the central tested ability is safe precision cutting.
